## Purpose and Integration
Statamic is a flat-first, Laravel- and Git-powered CMS distributed as a Composer package for an existing Laravel application. Package bootstrapping and framework bindings center on `src/Statamic.php`, `src/Providers/StatamicServiceProvider.php`, and `src/Providers/RouteServiceProvider.php`. HTTP surfaces are registered through `routes/web.php`, `routes/cp.php`, `routes/api.php`, and `routes/glide.php`.

## Content Domain and Storage
Core content models cover entries/collections, globals, taxonomies/terms, navigation structures, forms/submissions, and assets. Domain objects are separated from persistence contracts, enabling file-backed and alternative implementations: `src/Entries/Entry.php`, `src/Fields/Blueprint.php`, `src/Assets/Asset.php`; interfaces reside under `src/Contracts/Data`, `src/Contracts/Entries`, and `src/Contracts/Assets`.

The default flat-content read/query layer is the Stache: stores discover file-backed YAML/Markdown content, build indexes, and expose repositories/query builders. Key boundary: application code talks to repositories/contracts while Stache maps data to files and cached indexes. See `src/Stache/Stache.php`, `src/Stache/Stores/EntriesStore.php`, `src/Stache/Repositories/EntryRepository.php`.

## Authoring Schema and Transformation
Blueprints, fieldsets, fields, and fieldtypes define editable schemas and convert stored values for validation, publishing, querying, and rendering. `src/Fields/Blueprint.php`, `src/Fields/Fields.php`, and `src/Fields/Validator.php` provide the schema pipeline; concrete transformations include `src/Fieldtypes/Bard.php`, `src/Fieldtypes/Replicator.php`, and `src/Fieldtypes/Assets/Assets.php`. These types are a major extension boundary for custom content controls and data semantics.

## Request, Control Panel, and Frontend Delivery
Laravel controllers and middleware divide public frontend, Control Panel (CP), and API behavior. The CP is an Inertia/Vue application: PHP controllers serialize domain data and page props, while Vue pages/components render and edit it. Primary paths are `src/Http/Controllers/FrontendController.php`, `src/Http/Controllers/CP/CpController.php`, `src/Http/Middleware/CP/HandleInertiaRequests.php`, `resources/js/bootstrap/App.vue`, and `resources/js/pages/PublishForm.vue`.

Publishing flows from CP forms through field UI and save-pipeline logic to CP controllers, policies, domain repositories, events, and Stache/filesystem persistence. Relevant paths: `resources/js/components/ui/Publish/SavePipeline.js`, `src/CP/PublishForm.php`, `src/Http/Controllers/CP/Collections/EntriesController.php`.

## Rendering and Site Performance
Frontend requests resolve content and render Laravel Blade or Statamic Antlers templates. Antlers has its own lexer/parser/runtime and dispatches tags/modifiers against augmented content: `src/View/Antlers/Engine.php`, `src/View/Antlers/Language/Parser/LanguageParser.php`, `src/View/Antlers/Language/Runtime/NodeProcessor.php`. Blade interoperability is implemented by `src/View/Blade/StatamicTagCompiler.php`.

Static caching intercepts eligible responses, stores pages via application or files, and replaces dynamic no-cache regions at response time: `src/StaticCaching/Middleware/Cache.php`, `src/StaticCaching/StaticCacheManager.php`, `src/StaticCaching/NoCache/Region.php`.

## External Interfaces and Infrastructure
REST and GraphQL expose CMS data behind authentication, authorization, filtering/scoping, and response caching: `src/API/ServiceProvider.php`, `src/GraphQL/Manager.php`, `src/GraphQL/Middleware/HandleAuthentication.php`. Search is pluggable with local Comb, Algolia, and null implementations: `src/Search/IndexManager.php`, `src/Search/Comb/Index.php`, `src/Search/Algolia/Index.php`.

Assets abstract Laravel/Flysystem storage and support image manipulation through Glide/Intervention, remote retrieval via Guzzle, and queued preset generation: `src/Filesystem/Manager.php`, `src/Imaging/GlideManager.php`, `src/Jobs/GeneratePresetImageManipulation.php`. Git integration can commit content changes; licensing/marketplace services communicate with Statamic services: `src/Git/Git.php`, `src/Licensing/Outpost.php`, `src/Marketplace/Client.php`.

## Extensibility and Cross-Cutting Control
Laravel service providers, events, policies, actions, tags, modifiers, widgets, and add-ons form the principal extension mechanisms. Add-ons are discovered and registered through `src/Addons/AddonRepository.php` and `src/Providers/AddonServiceProvider.php`; lifecycle events in `src/Events` let writes trigger indexing, reference updates, cache invalidation, and integrations. Access control is consistently enforced by policies and CP middleware, notably `src/Policies/EntryPolicy.php`, `src/Auth/Permissions.php`, and `src/Http/Middleware/CP/Authorize.php`.
